name: uml-fragment-frame
description: Visio UML sequence fragment mapping for native VSDX generation. Every alt must drop the UML sequence stencil's 替代片段 / Alternative fragment master, keep the diagram header text as alt, replace the native [條件] placeholder for the first branch condition, normalize operand regions after layout, and keep first-branch condition heads without an extra visible top separator. Every opt must drop the UML sequence stencil's Optional fragment master and replace that native fragment's [參數] placeholder with the bracketed optional condition; do not emulate opt by changing an Alternative fragment operator or adding a separate condition title shape.
